verdict.rationale: Secureframe runs fixed automations in the background: daily continuous monitoring with alerts, automated evidence collection through integrations, automatic shadow-IT detection and drift monitoring. Users can also configure recurring access and vendor reviews, reminders, and task syncs to Jira/Slack or ticketing tools. However, there is no evidence of a general user-defined automation or workflow builder; the API and MCP key for CI jobs are only developer building blocks. Missing for 10: user-authored custom automation/workflow rules, AI agents acting autonomously on schedules or triggers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
